name: zinc finger homeobox 4
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ZFHX4 encodes zinc finger homeobox protein 4. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and zinc ion binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
